quarterly_data.signal: Celestica's Q2 2026 earnings release: CCS segment margin was 8.7% versus 8.3% for Q2 2025, and purchases of property, plant and equipment were $263.8 million in the three months ended June 30, 2026 ($32.5 million in Q2 2025). Q3 2026 adjusted EPS guidance is $2.88 to $3.08, and the CEO attributed the raised 2026 outlook to strong first-half performance, strengthening second-half customer forecasts and improved component supply.
